extracted.name: Best snowy Christmas cake
instruction_lines: Beat eggs and sugar vanilla together with a hand mixer until white and double in size.
Then add oil flour baking powder and soda salt continue with just a spatula turn from down to up
Pour the batter in a greased pan ligned with parchment paper
Bake in a preheated oven for 30 minutes 180 C 360 fahrenheit.
Whip the cream and icing sugar together until steaf peak after letting the cake cool then frost.
